source: Phase 1 frozen normalized_core.npz → subject nanmedian over cycles (label-blind). Not recomputed from raw MAT.
normalization_rationale: Z-score (zero mean, unit variance over the 101 points) discards ROM/amplitude and DC offset while preserving shape/timing. Applied before both Pearson and DTW so DTW cannot re-introduce amplitude. Pearson alone is already scale-invariant; the shared z-score keeps the two measures on the same representation.
note_pelvis: LPelvisAngles/RPelvisAngles are not in Phase 1 normalized_core (core pelvis = markers). LASI_ax1 and RASI_ax1 are the frozen Phase-1 pelvis proxies.
selection_rule: Primary sagittal/progress axis (ax1) for angles; pelvis markers LASI/RASI ax1; CentreOfMass ax1 + ax3. No post-hoc curve search.
